<div id="S2.Thmthm2" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_prop">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="S2.Thmthm2.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proposition 2.2</span></span></h6>
<div id="S2.Thmthm2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.Thmthm2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.Thmthm2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Let <math id="S2.Thmthm2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>R</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math> be a ring and <math id="S2.Thmthm2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma\leq\mathrm{PSL}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>≤</mo><mrow><msub><mi>PSL</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>ℤ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma\leq\mathrm{PSL}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})</annotation></semantics></math> be a subgroup of finite index such
that all the orders of all stabiliser groups <math id="S2.Thmthm2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma_{x}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mi>x</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma_{x}</annotation></semantics></math> for <math id="S2.Thmthm2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x\in\mathbb{H}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>ℍ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x\in\mathbb{H}</annotation></semantics></math> are invertible in <math id="S2.Thmthm2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>R</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math>.
Then for all <math id="S2.Thmthm2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R[\Gamma]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>R</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R[\Gamma]</annotation></semantics></math>-modules <math id="S2.Thmthm2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>V</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V</annotation></semantics></math> the sequence</span></p>
<table id="S2.Ex3" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S2.Ex3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0\to H_{\mathrm{par}}^{1}(\Gamma,V)\to H^{1}(\Gamma,V)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{res}}\prod_{g\in\Gamma\backslash\mathrm{PSL}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})/\langle T\rangle}H^{1}(\Gamma\cap\langle gTg^{-1}\rangle,V)\to V_{\Gamma}\to 0" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>H</mi><mi>par</mi><mn>1</mn></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>V</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mrow><msup><mi>H</mi><mn>1</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>V</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mover accent="true"><mo rspace="0.111em">→</mo><mo mathsize="0.700em">res</mo></mover><mrow><munder><mo movablelimits="false">∏</mo><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">\</mo><msub><mi>PSL</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>ℤ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mi>T</mi><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></munder><mrow><msup><mi>H</mi><mn>1</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>∩</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>T</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>g</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi>V</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><msub><mi>V</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0\to H_{\mathrm{par}}^{1}(\Gamma,V)\to H^{1}(\Gamma,V)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{res}}\prod_{g\in\Gamma\backslash\mathrm{PSL}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})/\langle T\rangle}H^{1}(\Gamma\cap\langle gTg^{-1}\rangle,V)\to V_{\Gamma}\to 0</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S2.Thmthm2.p1.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.Thmthm2.p1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">is exact.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div id="S2.SSx2.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.SSx2.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.SSx2.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proof. </span>Due to the assumptions we may apply Corollary <a href="#S2.Thmthm1" title="Corollary 2.1 ‣ Cohomology of PSL_2⁢(ℤ) ‣ 2 Parabolic group cohomology ‣ On the faithfulness of parabolic cohomologyas a Hecke module over a finite field" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.1</span></a>.
The restriction map in Equation (<a href="#S2.E5" title="In Definition of parabolic group cohomology ‣ 2 Parabolic group cohomology ‣ On the faithfulness of parabolic cohomologyas a Hecke module over a finite field" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.5</span></a>) thus becomes</p>
<table id="S2.Ex4" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S2.Ex4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="M/(M^{\langle\sigma\rangle}+M^{\langle\tau\rangle})\xrightarrow{m\mapsto(1-\sigma)m}M/(1-T)M," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo>/</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>M</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mi>σ</mi><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>M</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mi>τ</mi><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></msup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mover accent="true"><mo>→</mo><mrow><mi mathsize="0.700em">m</mi><mo mathsize="0.700em" stretchy="false">↦</mo><mrow><mrow><mo maxsize="0.700em" minsize="0.700em">(</mo><mrow><mn mathsize="0.700em">1</mn><mo mathsize="0.700em">−</mo><mi mathsize="0.700em">σ</mi></mrow><mo maxsize="0.700em" minsize="0.700em">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathsize="0.700em">m</mi></mrow></mrow></mover><mrow><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo>/</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>T</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>M</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">M/(M^{\langle\sigma\rangle}+M^{\langle\tau\rangle})\xrightarrow{m\mapsto(1-\sigma)m}M/(1-T)M,</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S2.SSx2.p2.2" class="ltx_p">since <math id="S2.SSx2.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H^{1}(\langle T\rangle,M)\cong M/(1-T)M" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>H</mi><mn>1</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mi>T</mi><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi>M</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≅</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo>/</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>T</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>M</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">H^{1}(\langle T\rangle,M)\cong M/(1-T)M</annotation></semantics></math>.
The isomorphism <math id="S2.SSx2.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="M\cong(R[\mathrm{PSL}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})]\otimes_{R}V)_{\Gamma}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo>≅</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>R</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>PSL</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>ℤ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.055em" stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><msub><mo rspace="0.222em">⊗</mo><mi>R</mi></msub><mi>V</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">M\cong(R[\mathrm{PSL}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})]\otimes_{R}V)_{\Gamma}</annotation></semantics></math> allows
one to compute that the cokernel of this map is <math id="S2.SSx2.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{\Gamma}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>V</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{\Gamma}</annotation></semantics></math>, the <math id="S2.SSx2.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma</annotation></semantics></math>-coinvariants.
∎</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S2.SSx3" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection">The module <math id="S2.SSx3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{n}(R)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{n}(R)</annotation></semantics></math></h3>

<div id="S2.SSx3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.SSx3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Let <math id="S2.SSx3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>R</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math> be a ring.
Recall from Notation <a href="#S1.SS1" title="1.1 Notation ‣ 1 Introduction ‣ On the faithfulness of parabolic cohomologyas a Hecke module over a finite field" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">1.1</span></a> that we put
<math id="S2.SSx3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{n}(R)=\Sym^{n}(R^{2})\cong R[X,Y]_{n}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mi>Sym</mi><mi>n</mi></msup><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≅</mo><mrow><mi>R</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mi>X</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Y</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mi>n</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{n}(R)=\Sym^{n}(R^{2})\cong R[X,Y]_{n}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
<div id="S2.Thmthm3" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_prop">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="S2.Thmthm3.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proposition 2.3</span></span></h6>
<div id="S2.Thmthm3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Suppose that <math id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n!" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>!</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n!</annotation></semantics></math> is invertible in <math id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>R</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math>. Then there is a perfect pairing</span></p>
<table id="S2.Ex5" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S2.Ex5.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{n}(R)\times V_{n}(R)\to R" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo rspace="0.055em" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.222em">×</mo><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mi>R</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{n}(R)\times V_{n}(R)\to R</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">of <math id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>R</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math>-modules, which induces
an isomorphism <math id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{n}(R)\to V_{n}(R)^{\vee}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>∨</mo></msup></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{n}(R)\to V_{n}(R)^{\vee}</annotation></semantics></math> of <math id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>R</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math>-modules
respecting the <math id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{Mat}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})_{\neq 0}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>Mat</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>ℤ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>≠</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{Mat}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})_{\neq 0}</annotation></semantics></math>-action which is given on <math id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{n}(R)^{\vee}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>∨</mo></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{n}(R)^{\vee}</annotation></semantics></math> by
<math id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.m8" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="(M.\phi)(w)=\phi(M^{\iota}w)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>M</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">.</mo><mi>ϕ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>w</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>ϕ</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>M</mi><mi>ι</mi></msup><mi>w</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(M.\phi)(w)=\phi(M^{\iota}w)</annotation></semantics></math> for <math id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="M\in\mathrm{Mat}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})_{\neq 0}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><msub><mi>Mat</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>ℤ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>≠</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">M\in\mathrm{Mat}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})_{\neq 0}</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\phi\in V_{n}(R)^{\vee}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>ϕ</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>∨</mo></msup></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\phi\in V_{n}(R)^{\vee}</annotation></semantics></math>
and <math id="S2.Thmthm3.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w\in V_{n}(R)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>w</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">w\in V_{n}(R)</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div id="S2.SSx3.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.SSx3.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.SSx3.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proof. </span>One defines the perfect pairing on <math id="S2.SSx3.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{n}(R)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{n}(R)</annotation></semantics></math>
by first constructing a perfect pairing on <math id="S2.SSx3.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R^{2}</annotation></semantics></math>, which we consider
as column vectors. One sets</p>
<table id="S2.Ex6" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S2.Ex6.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R^{2}\times R^{2}\to R,\;\;\langle v,w\rangle:=\det(v|w)=v_{1}w_{2}-v_{2}w_{1}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><msup><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mi>R</mi></mrow><mo rspace="0.727em">,</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>w</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow><mo rspace="0.1389em">:=</mo><mrow><mo lspace="0.1389em" movablelimits="false" rspace="0em">det</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">|</mo><mi>w</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>w</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>w</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R^{2}\times R^{2}\to R,\;\;\langle v,w\rangle:=\det(v|w)=v_{1}w_{2}-v_{2}w_{1}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S2.SSx3.p2.2" class="ltx_p">If <math id="S2.SSx3.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="M" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>M</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">M</annotation></semantics></math> is a matrix in <math id="S2.SSx3.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{Mat}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})_{\neq 0}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>Mat</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>ℤ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>≠</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{Mat}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})_{\neq 0}</annotation></semantics></math>, one checks easily that
<math id="S2.SSx3.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\langle Mv,w\rangle=\langle v,M^{\iota}w\rangle" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi>w</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><msup><mi>M</mi><mi>ι</mi></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>w</mi></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\langle Mv,w\rangle=\langle v,M^{\iota}w\rangle</annotation></semantics></math>.
This pairing extends naturally to a pairing on the <math id="S2.SSx3.p2.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>n</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n</annotation></semantics></math>-th tensor power of <math id="S2.SSx3.p2.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R^{2}</annotation></semantics></math>.
Due to the assumption on the invertibility of <math id="S2.SSx3.p2.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n!" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>!</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n!</annotation></semantics></math>,
we may view <math id="S2.SSx3.p2.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Sym^{n}(R^{2})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>Sym</mi><mi>n</mi></msup><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Sym^{n}(R^{2})</annotation></semantics></math> as a submodule in the <math id="S2.SSx3.p2.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>n</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n</annotation></semantics></math>-th tensor power, and hence
obtain the desired pairing and the isomorphism of the statement.
∎</p>
</div>
<div id="S2.Thmthm4" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_lem">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="S2.Thmthm4.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Lemma 2.4</span></span></h6>
<div id="S2.Thmthm4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Let <math id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n\geq 1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n\geq 1</annotation></semantics></math> be an integer, <math id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}1&amp;N\\
0&amp;1\end{smallmatrix}\right)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mtable columnspacing="5pt" rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd><mn mathsize="0.700em">1</mn></mtd><mtd><mi mathsize="0.700em">N</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn mathsize="0.700em">0</mn></mtd><mtd><mn mathsize="0.700em">1</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}1&amp;N\\
0&amp;1\end{smallmatrix}\right)</annotation></semantics></math> and
<math id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t^{\prime}=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}1&amp;0\\
N&amp;1\end{smallmatrix}\right)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>t</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mtable columnspacing="5pt" rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd><mn mathsize="0.700em">1</mn></mtd><mtd><mn mathsize="0.700em">0</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi mathsize="0.700em">N</mi></mtd><mtd><mn mathsize="0.700em">1</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t^{\prime}=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}1&amp;0\\
N&amp;1\end{smallmatrix}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>.
If <math id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n!N" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>!</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n!N</annotation></semantics></math> is not a zero divisor in <math id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>R</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math>, then
for the <math id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>t</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math>-invariants we have
<math id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{n}(R)^{\langle t\rangle}=\langle X^{n}\rangle" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><msup><mi>X</mi><mi>n</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{n}(R)^{\langle t\rangle}=\langle X^{n}\rangle</annotation></semantics></math>
and for the <math id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t^{\prime}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>t</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t^{\prime}</annotation></semantics></math>-invariants
<math id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{n}(R)^{\langle t^{\prime}\rangle}=\langle Y^{n}\rangle" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><msup><mi>t</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><msup><mi>Y</mi><mi>n</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{n}(R)^{\langle t^{\prime}\rangle}=\langle Y^{n}\rangle</annotation></semantics></math>.
If <math id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n!N" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>!</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n!N</annotation></semantics></math> is invertible in <math id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>R</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math>, then the coinvariants are
given by
<math id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{n}(R)_{\langle t\rangle}=V_{n}(R)/\langle Y^{n},XY^{n-1},\dots,X^{n-1}Y\rangle" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mrow><msup><mi>Y</mi><mi>n</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>X</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><msup><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>Y</mi></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{n}(R)_{\langle t\rangle}=V_{n}(R)/\langle Y^{n},XY^{n-1},\dots,X^{n-1}Y\rangle</annotation></semantics></math>
respectively
<math id="S2.Thmthm4.p1.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{n}(R)_{\langle t^{\prime}\rangle}=V_{n}(R)/\langle X^{n},X^{n-1}Y,\dots,XY^{n-1}\rangle" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><msup><mi>t</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mrow><msup><mi>X</mi><mi>n</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mrow><msup><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>Y</mi></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>X</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>Y</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{n}(R)_{\langle t^{\prime}\rangle}=V_{n}(R)/\langle X^{n},X^{n-1}Y,\dots,XY^{n-1}\rangle</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div id="S2.SSx3.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.SSx3.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.SSx3.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proof. </span>The action of <math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>t</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math> is <math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t.(X^{n-i}Y^{i})=X^{n-i}(NX+Y)^{i}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">.</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>Y</mi><mi>i</mi></msup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>X</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>Y</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mi>i</mi></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t.(X^{n-i}Y^{i})=X^{n-i}(NX+Y)^{i}</annotation></semantics></math> and consequently
<math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(t-1).(X^{n-i}Y^{i})=\sum_{j=0}^{i-1}r_{i,j}X^{n-j}Y^{j}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">.</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>Y</mi><mi>i</mi></msup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo rspace="0.111em">=</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msubsup><mrow><msub><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>Y</mi><mi>j</mi></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(t-1).(X^{n-i}Y^{i})=\sum_{j=0}^{i-1}r_{i,j}X^{n-j}Y^{j}</annotation></semantics></math>
with <math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{i,j}=N^{i-j}\left(\begin{smallmatrix}i\\
j\end{smallmatrix}\right)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mi>N</mi><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mtable rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd><mi mathsize="0.700em">i</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi mathsize="0.700em">j</mi></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{i,j}=N^{i-j}\left(\begin{smallmatrix}i\\
j\end{smallmatrix}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>, which is not a zero divisor,
respectively invertible, by assumption.
For <math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x=\sum_{i=0}^{n}a_{i}X^{n-i}Y^{i}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo rspace="0.111em">=</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><mi>n</mi></msubsup><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>Y</mi><mi>i</mi></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x=\sum_{i=0}^{n}a_{i}X^{n-i}Y^{i}</annotation></semantics></math> we have
<math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(t-1).x=\sum_{j=0}^{n-1}X^{n-j}Y^{j}(\sum_{i=j+1}^{n}a_{i}r_{i,j})." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">.</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo rspace="0.111em">=</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msubsup><mrow><msup><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>Y</mi><mi>j</mi></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo lspace="0em">∑</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mrow><mi>n</mi></msubsup><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(t-1).x=\sum_{j=0}^{n-1}X^{n-j}Y^{j}(\sum_{i=j+1}^{n}a_{i}r_{i,j}).</annotation></semantics></math>
If <math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(t-1).x=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">.</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(t-1).x=0</annotation></semantics></math>, we conclude for <math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="j=n-1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">j=n-1</annotation></semantics></math> that <math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a_{n}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a_{n}=0</annotation></semantics></math>.
Next, for <math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="j=n-2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">j=n-2</annotation></semantics></math> it follows that <math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a_{n-1}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a_{n-1}=0</annotation></semantics></math>,
and so on, until <math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a_{1}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a_{1}=0</annotation></semantics></math>. This proves the statement on
the <math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>t</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math>-invariants. The one on the <math id="S2.SSx3.p3.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t^{\prime}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>t</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t^{\prime}</annotation></semantics></math>-invariants follows from symmetry.
The claims on the coinvariants are proved in a very similar and
straightforward way.
∎</p>
</div>
<div id="S2.Thmthm5" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_prop">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="S2.Thmthm5.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proposition 2.5</span></span></h6>
<div id="S2.Thmthm5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.Thmthm5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.Thmthm5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Let <math id="S2.Thmthm5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n\geq 1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n\geq 1</annotation></semantics></math> be an integer.</span></p>
<ol id="S2.I1" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="S2.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(a)</span> 
<div id="S2.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">If </span><math id="S2.I1.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n!N" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>!</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n!N</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> is not a zero divisor in </span><math id="S2.I1.i1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>R</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">,
then the </span><math id="S2.I1.i1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>R</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i1.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">-module of </span><math id="S2.I1.i1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma(N)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>N</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma(N)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i1.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">-invariants </span><math id="S2.I1.i1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{n}(R)^{\Gamma(N)}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>N</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{n}(R)^{\Gamma(N)}</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i1.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> is zero.</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="S2.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(b)</span> 
<div id="S2.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">If </span><math id="S2.I1.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n!N" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>!</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n!N</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> is invertible in </span><math id="S2.I1.i2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>R</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i2.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">,
then the </span><math id="S2.I1.i2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>R</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i2.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">-module of </span><math id="S2.I1.i2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma(N)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>N</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma(N)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i2.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">-coinvariants </span><math id="S2.I1.i2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{n}(R)_{\Gamma(N)}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>N</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{n}(R)_{\Gamma(N)}</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i2.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> is zero.</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="S2.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(c)</span> 
<div id="S2.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Suppose that </span><math id="S2.I1.i3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> is a subgroup of </span><math id="S2.I1.i3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{SL}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>SL</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>ℤ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{SL}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> such
that reduction modulo </span><math id="S2.I1.i3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>p</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> defines a surjection </span><math id="S2.I1.i3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma\twoheadrightarrow\mathrm{SL}_{2}(\mathbb{F}_{p})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo stretchy="false">↠</mo><mrow><msub><mi>SL</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝔽</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma\twoheadrightarrow\mathrm{SL}_{2}(\mathbb{F}_{p})</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">
(e.g. </span><math id="S2.I1.i3.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma(N)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>N</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma(N)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, </span><math id="S2.I1.i3.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma_{1}(N)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>N</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma_{1}(N)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, </span><math id="S2.I1.i3.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma_{0}(N)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>N</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma_{0}(N)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> for </span><math id="S2.I1.i3.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p\nmid N" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>∤</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p\nmid N</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">).
Suppose moreover that </span><math id="S2.I1.i3.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1\leq n\leq p" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>≤</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>≤</mo><mi>p</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1\leq n\leq p</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> if </span><math id="S2.I1.i3.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p&gt;2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p&gt;2</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, and </span><math id="S2.I1.i3.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n=1</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> if </span><math id="S2.I1.i3.p1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p=2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p=2</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I1.i3.p1.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">.
Then one has </span><math id="S2.I1.i3.p1.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{n}(\mathbb{F}_{p})^{\Gamma}=0=V_{n}(\mathbb{F}_{p})_{\Gamma}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝔽</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi></msup></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝔽</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{n}(\mathbb{F}_{p})^{\Gamma}=0=V_{n}(\mathbb{F}_{p})_{\Gamma}.</annotation></semantics></math></p>
</div></li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div id="S2.SSx3.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.SSx3.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.SSx3.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proof. </span>As <math id="S2.SSx3.p4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma(N)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>N</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma(N)</annotation></semantics></math> contains the matrices <math id="S2.SSx3.p4.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>t</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="S2.SSx3.p4.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t^{\prime}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>t</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t^{\prime}</annotation></semantics></math>, Lemma <a href="#S2.Thmthm4" title="Lemma 2.4 ‣ The module 𝑉_𝑛⁢(𝑅) ‣ 2 Parabolic group cohomology ‣ On the faithfulness of parabolic cohomologyas a Hecke module over a finite field" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.4</span></a>
already finishes Parts (a) and (b).
The only part of (c) that is not yet covered is when the degree is <math id="S2.SSx3.p4.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n=p&gt;2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n=p&gt;2</annotation></semantics></math>.
Since <math id="S2.SSx3.p4.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="V_{p}(\mathbb{F}_{p})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝔽</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V_{p}(\mathbb{F}_{p})</annotation></semantics></math> is naturally isomorphic to <math id="S2.SSx3.p4.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="U_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>U</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">U_{1}</annotation></semantics></math>,
Proposition <a href="#S4.Thmthm1" title="Proposition 4.1 ‣ Decomposition of 𝒲(𝑝,𝔽_𝑝) as 𝔽_𝑝⁢[Mat_2⁢(ℤ)_{≠0}]-module ‣ 4 Reduction to weight 2 for parabolic group cohomology ‣ On the faithfulness of parabolic cohomologyas a Hecke module over a finite field" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">4.1</span></a> gives the exact sequence of <math id="S2.SSx3.p4.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma</annotation></semantics></math>-modules
<math id="S2.SSx3.p4.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0\to V_{1}(\mathbb{F}_{p})\to V_{p}(\mathbb{F}_{p})\to V_{p-2}(\mathbb{F}_{p})\to 0." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝔽</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝔽</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝔽</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0\to V_{1}(\mathbb{F}_{p})\to V_{p}(\mathbb{F}_{p})\to V_{p-2}(\mathbb{F}_{p})\to 0.</annotation></semantics></math>
It suffices to take invariants respectively coinvariants to obtain the result.
∎</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S2.SSx4" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection">Torsion-freeness and base change properties</h3>

<div id="S2.SSx4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.SSx4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Herremans has computed a torsion-freeness result like the following proposition
in <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib13" title="" class="ltx_ref">13</a>]</cite>, Proposition 9.
Here we give a short and conceptual proof of a slightly more general statement.
The way of approach was suggested by Bas Edixhoven.</p>
</div>
<div id="S2.Thmthm6" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_prop">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="S2.Thmthm6.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proposition 2.6</span></span></h6>
<div id="S2.Thmthm6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Assume that <math id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>R</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math> is an integral domain of characteristic <math id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0</annotation></semantics></math>
such that <math id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R/pR\cong\mathbb{F}_{p}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>R</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>p</mi></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>R</mi></mrow><mo>≅</mo><msub><mi>𝔽</mi><mi>p</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R/pR\cong\mathbb{F}_{p}</annotation></semantics></math> for a prime <math id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>p</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p</annotation></semantics></math>.
Let <math id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="N\geq 1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">N\geq 1</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k\geq 2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k\geq 2</annotation></semantics></math> be integers and let <math id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma\leq\mathrm{SL}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>≤</mo><mrow><msub><mi>SL</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>ℤ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma\leq\mathrm{SL}_{2}(\mathbb{Z})</annotation></semantics></math>
be a subgroup containing <math id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma(N)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>N</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma(N)</annotation></semantics></math> but not <math id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="-1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-1</annotation></semantics></math> such that
the orders of the stabiliser subgroups <math id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma_{x}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mi>x</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma_{x}</annotation></semantics></math> for <math id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x\in\mathbb{H}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>ℍ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x\in\mathbb{H}</annotation></semantics></math>
have order coprime to <math id="S2.Thmthm6.p1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>p</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p</annotation></semantics></math>.
Then the following statements hold:</span></p>
<ol id="S2.I2" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="S2.I2.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(a)</span> 
<div id="S2.I2.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.I2.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><math id="S2.I2.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(R))\otimes_{R}\mathbb{F}_{p}\cong H^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(\mathbb{F}_{p}))" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>H</mi><mn>1</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.055em" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><msub><mo rspace="0.222em">⊗</mo><mi>R</mi></msub><msub><mi>𝔽</mi><mi>p</mi></msub></mrow><mo>≅</mo><mrow><msup><mi>H</mi><mn>1</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝔽</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">H^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(R))\otimes_{R}\mathbb{F}_{p}\cong H^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(\mathbb{F}_{p}))</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I2.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">.</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="S2.I2.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(b)</span> 
<div id="S2.I2.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.I2.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.I2.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">If </span><math id="S2.I2.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k=2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k=2</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I2.i2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, then </span><math id="S2.I2.i2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(R))[p]=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>H</mi><mn>1</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">H^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(R))[p]=0</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I2.i2.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">.
If </span><math id="S2.I2.i2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k\geq 3" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k\geq 3</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I2.i2.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, then </span><math id="S2.I2.i2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(R))[p]=V_{k-2}(\mathbb{F}_{p})^{\Gamma}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>H</mi><mn>1</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝔽</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi></msup></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">H^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(R))[p]=V_{k-2}(\mathbb{F}_{p})^{\Gamma}</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I2.i2.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">.
In particular, if </span><math id="S2.I2.i2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p\nmid N" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>∤</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p\nmid N</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I2.i2.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, then </span><math id="S2.I2.i2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(R))[p]=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>H</mi><mn>1</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">H^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(R))[p]=0</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I2.i2.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">
for all </span><math id="S2.I2.i2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k\in\{2,\dots,p+2\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k\in\{2,\dots,p+2\}</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I2.i2.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">.</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="S2.I2.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(c)</span> 
<div id="S2.I2.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.I2.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.I2.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">If </span><math id="S2.I2.i3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k=2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k=2</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I2.i3.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, or if </span><math id="S2.I2.i3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k\in\{3,\dots,p+2\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k\in\{3,\dots,p+2\}</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I2.i3.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> and </span><math id="S2.I2.i3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p\nmid N" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>∤</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p\nmid N</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I2.i3.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, then
</span><math id="S2.I2.i3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H_{\mathrm{par}}^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(R))\otimes_{R}\mathbb{F}_{p}\cong H_{\mathrm{par}}^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(\mathbb{F}_{p}))" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mi>H</mi><mi>par</mi><mn>1</mn></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>R</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.055em" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><msub><mo rspace="0.222em">⊗</mo><mi>R</mi></msub><msub><mi>𝔽</mi><mi>p</mi></msub></mrow><mo>≅</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>H</mi><mi>par</mi><mn>1</mn></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>V</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝔽</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">H_{\mathrm{par}}^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(R))\otimes_{R}\mathbb{F}_{p}\cong H_{\mathrm{par}}^{1}(\Gamma,V_{k-2}(\mathbb{F}_{p}))</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I2.i3.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">.</span></p>
</div></li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>

<p id="S2.SSx4.p2.3" class="ltx_p">for every <math id="S2.SSx4.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="i\geq 0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">i\geq 0</annotation></semantics></math>.
Exploiting this sequence for <math id="S2.SSx4.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="i=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">i=1</annotation></semantics></math> immediately yields Part (a), since
any <math id="S2.SSx4.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>H</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">H^{2}</annotation></semantics></math> of <math id="S2.SSx4.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma</annotation></semantics></math> is zero by Corollary <a href="#S2.Thmthm1" title="Corollary 2.1 ‣ Cohomology of PSL_2⁢(ℤ) ‣ 2 Parabolic group cohomology ‣ On the faithfulness of parabolic cohomologyas a Hecke module over a finite field" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.1</span></a>.

Proposition <a href="#S2.Thmthm5" title="Proposition 2.5 ‣ The module 𝑉_𝑛⁢(𝑅) ‣ 2 Parabolic group cohomology ‣ On the faithfulness of parabolic cohomologyas a Hecke module over a finite field" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.5</span></a>.</p>
